title: Reverse an Array
description: Given an array of integers `nums`, reverse the elements in-place and output the reversed array.
input_format: First line contains integer `n`, followed by `n` space-separated integers.
hints: Use two pointers: left at 0 and right at n - 1.
Swap nums[left] and nums[right], then move left rightward and right leftward.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n = int(data[0])
    nums = data[1:1+n]
    print(' '.join(reversed(nums)))
